add.whoA: A teammate on Indigarr who joins the goat argument.
add.whoB: A teammate on Indigarr who joins the goat argument.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: When Quill objects to the kidnapped Kevin Bacon that Mantis gives him for Christmas, Rocket backs up her gift.
add.whoA: A teammate who defends Mantis's gift of Kevin Bacon to Quill.
add.whoB: A teammate whose gift of Kevin Bacon Rocket defends.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Mantis stays on Counter-Earth to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks her into going after Quill.
add.whoA: A teammate Mantis stays behind to guard.
add.whoB: A teammate who stays behind to guard Rocket.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In the battle against Thanos, a Gamora from 2014 knocks Quill down, and he turns to Nebula, confused, as she tells Gamora that her other self fell for him. Afterward Nebula joins Quill's Guardians on the Benatar.
add.whoA: The Guardian whose Gamora fell for him. Nebula joins his team after the war.
add.whoB: Explains Quill to a Gamora from 2014, then joins his Guardians.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Nebula fights the Booskans on Indigarr in the team Quill leads, and both watch the God Butcher distress calls before saying goodbye to Thor.
add.whoA: The Guardians' leader on Indigarr.
add.whoB: A Guardian on Quill's team at Indigarr.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: Nebula switches on the lights for the surprise Christmas party the team throws Quill. When the kidnapped Kevin Bacon runs off, Quill sends her after him and asks her not to kill him.
add.whoA: A teammate who sends Nebula after the fleeing Kevin Bacon.
add.whoB: A teammate who lights up Quill's Christmas party and chases down Bacon.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Nebula keeps carrying the drunk, grieving Quill to bed on Knowhere, and he mistakes her for Gamora. She later stops Gamora from attacking him.
add.whoA: A teammate Nebula looks after through his grief.
add.whoB: A teammate who carries Quill to bed and defends him.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back after five years gone, Ned spots Peter at school and the two best friends share an emotional reunion.
add.whoA: Ned's best friend, reunited with him at school after the Blip.
add.whoB: Peter's best friend, who runs to him at school after the Blip.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When a spaceship appears over New York during a school field trip, Ned creates a distraction on the bus so Peter can slip away and suit up.
add.whoA: Slips off the field trip bus to suit up while Ned covers for him.
add.whoB: Covers for Peter on the field trip bus.

add.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
add.text: In Prague Ned covers for Peter by calling his black suit Night Monkey, a European knock-off. When Peter leaves for Berlin, Ned agrees to tell the class he is staying with family.
add.whoA: A best friend Ned covers for as Night Monkey.
add.whoB: A best friend who covers for Peter's Night Monkey suit and his trip to Berlin.

add.title: Peter's To-Do List
add.text: Before their class trip to Europe, Peter tells Ned about the errands he has to run, from picking up his passport to taking down the Manfredi crime family.
add.whoA: Tells Ned his to-do list before Europe, crime family included.
add.whoB: Hears Peter's to-do list before the class trip to Europe.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: When Shuri returns from the Blip, Okoye is reunited with her and walks beside her and T'Challa through a sorcerer's portal to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
add.whoA: Returns from the Blip and marches into battle at Okoye's side.
add.whoB: Reunited with Shuri after the Blip, she leads Wakanda's army beside her.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Okoye is in Shuri's lab as Shuri explains how she can remove the Mind Stone from Vision, until an alert warns Okoye of ships entering the atmosphere.
add.whoA: Works to save Vision as Okoye looks on.
add.whoB: Stands by in Shuri's lab while she studies Vision.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: When T'Challa returns from the Blip, Okoye is at his side again, and they walk through a sorcerer's portal together to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
add.whoA: Okoye's king, back from the Blip. She leads his army into battle beside him.
add.whoB: T'Challa's general, back at his side to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Okoye fights at T'Challa's side in the battle for Wakanda, and when Thanos snaps his fingers T'Challa turns to dust in front of her as he reaches to help her up.
add.whoA: Okoye's king, who turns to dust beside her.
add.whoB: Fights at T'Challa's side in Wakanda.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Reunited after the Blip, Rocket and Quill mourn Tony with the Guardians. When Thor joins them on the Benatar and questions Quill's leadership, Rocket offers blasters to settle it.
add.whoA: Back with Quill after the Blip. Offers blasters when Thor questions his leadership.
add.whoB: Back with Rocket after the Blip, defending his place as the Guardians' leader.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Quill and Rocket help pull Thor from space, then the Guardians split up: Rocket flies off with Thor to Nidavellir while Quill leads the others to Knowhere.
add.whoA: Leaves with Thor for Nidavellir as the Guardians split.
add.whoB: Leads the other Guardians to Knowhere as the team splits.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Quill and Rocket fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, and Rocket waits with the team while Quill talks with Thor before they fly off together.
add.whoA: A teammate who fights beside Quill on Indigarr.
add.whoB: The Guardians' leader on Indigarr.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: When Quill is horrified that his friends kidnapped Kevin Bacon for him, Rocket argues a human being is the perfect gift for the man who has everything. He then tries to calm the panicking Bacon.
add.whoA: A friend who defends kidnapping Kevin Bacon as Quill's gift.
add.whoB: A friend horrified by his kidnapped Christmas present.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
add.text: Quill and Rocket argue after Rocket's theft gets the ship shot down, but Rocket comes to Ego's planet to rescue Quill and builds the bomb that kills Ego.
add.whoA: A teammate who argues with Quill, then helps save him from Ego.
add.whoB: Argues with Rocket, who then helps save him from Ego.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Restored on Titan, Quill steps through the portal Stephen Strange opens to Earth and joins the battle against Thanos's army.
add.whoA: The sorcerer whose portal takes Quill from Titan to the battle.
add.whoB: A Guardian Strange brings from Titan to the battle.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Thor joins the Guardians aboard the Benatar, and Quill reminds him that it is still his ship and he is in charge. Thor agrees, and they laugh off the idea of fighting for the lead.
add.whoA: Joins Quill's Guardians, and agrees Quill is in charge.
add.whoB: The Guardian who tells Thor the ship is still his.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Wong brings the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj and allies from across the universe through portals to fight Thanos's army. When Strange asks if that is everyone, Wong asks whether he wanted more.
add.whoA: Brings the sorcerers to the battle beside Strange.
add.whoB: The friend who asks Wong if that is everyone.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Wong is with Strange in the Sanctum when Bruce Banner crashes in with word of Thanos, and they fight Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian together in New York before Maw takes Strange and Wong stays to guard the Sanctum.
add.whoA: A friend who fights beside Strange in New York.
add.whoB: A friend taken by Ebony Maw in New York.

add.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
add.text: Strange and Wong save America Chavez from a demon in New York and try to protect her from Wanda at Kamar-Taj. Later, with Wong's help, Strange saves Chavez from Wanda at Mount Wundagore.
add.whoA: Close friend. Helps Strange protect America Chavez from Wanda.
add.whoB: Wong's friend. Fights beside him to protect America Chavez from Wanda.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: T'Challa leads Wakanda's armies through a portal to the ruined Avengers Compound, sharing a look with a battered Steve Rogers, then joins the charge Steve leads against Thanos's army.
add.whoA: Wakanda's king, whose arrival through a portal relieves Steve.
add.whoB: The battered leader T'Challa joins in the charge against Thanos.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: As T'Challa runs with the gauntlet, Thanos charges at him, but Wanda blocks the Titan's path and fights him while T'Challa runs on.
add.whoA: The witch who blocks Thanos's charge at T'Challa.
add.whoB: The king Wanda saves from Thanos's charge.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: As T'Challa runs for the van with the gauntlet, Thanos knocks him down with his sword and charges at him, until Wanda blocks his path.
add.whoA: Knocks T'Challa down with his sword to get the gauntlet.
add.whoB: Runs with the gauntlet until Thanos knocks him down with his sword.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: The Guardians pick Thor up at New Asgard, and when he and Quill argue over who leads, Mantis joins in and agrees they should settle it with knives.
add.whoA: A Guardian who joins the banter when Thor comes aboard.
add.whoB: The Asgardian who joins the Guardians at New Asgard.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Rhodes and Thor join the strike at the Garden, where Rhodes doubts Thanos's claim that the Stones are gone and Thor beheads Thanos.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger on the strike against Thanos at the Garden.
add.whoB: A fellow Avenger on the strike at the Garden, where Thor beheads Thanos.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In 2012 New York, Sitwell and Rumlow's STRIKE team take Loki's scepter to move it for HYDRA. Rumlow refuses to give it to Steve, but they hand it over once Steve whispers "Hail Hydra" to Sitwell.
add.whoA: A fellow HYDRA mole moving the scepter with Rumlow's team in 2012.
add.whoB: The STRIKE leader beside Sitwell as they move the scepter in 2012.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Ayo stands with T'Challa and the Dora Milaje as he welcomes the Avengers to Wakanda. She stays behind to guard Shuri while he leads the defense against Thanos's army.
add.whoA: Ayo's king. She guards Shuri while he leads Wakanda's defense.
add.whoB: T'Challa's guard, who protects Shuri during the battle.

add.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
add.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Ayo helps carry his casket at his funeral.
add.whoA: Ayo's king, whose casket she helps carry.
add.whoB: A Dora Milaje guard who helps carry T'Challa's casket.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Aboard the Statesman, Loki stalls Thanos and tells him they have a Hulk, and the Hulk springs from hiding to attack Thanos.
add.whoA: Stalls Thanos so the Hulk can ambush him.
add.whoB: Attacks Thanos on Loki's cue aboard the Statesman.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Bruce calls Steve to warn him that Thanos is coming for Vision, then rejoins him at the Avengers Compound. They fight side by side in Wakanda, where Bruce points Thanos out to him.
add.whoA: An old friend Bruce calls for help, then fights beside in Wakanda.
add.whoB: An old friend who warns Steve about Thanos and fights beside him.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Steve tries to stop Bruce and Tony from bringing their new synthetic body to life, and the team turns on itself over it.
add.whoA: A friend who tries to stop Bruce bringing the synthetic body to life.
add.whoB: A friend whose work on the synthetic body Steve tries to stop.

add.title: Captain Marvel
add.text: After the Snap, Bruce and Steve work together at the Avengers compound to find out who Fury's pager was signaling.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger studying Fury's pager with Bruce after the Snap.
add.whoB: A fellow Avenger studying Fury's pager with Steve after the Snap.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Bruce crash-lands on Earth and warns Tony about Thanos, pushing him to call Steve despite their split. Tony protects Bruce in New York when the Hulk refuses to come out.
add.whoA: A friend Bruce warns about Thanos, who protects him in New York.
add.whoB: A friend who warns Tony about Thanos and pushes him to call Steve.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: Tony pours out the story of his battle with Killian to Bruce, who falls asleep partway through and admits he is not that kind of doctor.
add.whoA: Pours his troubles out to Bruce, who dozes off.
add.whoB: Listens to Tony's story and falls asleep partway through.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Vision offers to die to destroy the Mind Stone, Bruce argues he is more than the Stone and proposes removing it instead. He then fights in Wakanda to protect Vision.
add.whoA: A friend Bruce refuses to let die for the Mind Stone.
add.whoB: Argues Vision is more than the Stone and fights to protect him.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Steve and Bucky reunite with a hug in Wakanda and fight side by side against Thanos's army. After the Snap, Bucky calls out to Steve as he turns to dust.
add.whoA: Bucky's best friend, reunited in Wakanda. Bucky turns to dust calling his name.
add.whoB: Steve's best friend, who fades to dust calling his name.

add.title: Ant-Man
add.text: Steve Rogers finally has Bucky Barnes, holding him in custody with Sam Wilson. Unable to turn to Tony Stark because of the Accords, Steve fears they are on their own.
add.whoA: Bucky's best friend. Holds him in custody, unable to turn to Tony.
add.whoB: Steve's best friend, finally found and held in custody.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Aboard the Benatar, Drax tells Thor that Gamora is Thanos's daughter. On Knowhere, he yells at Thanos for taking her captive, and Thanos breaks him into pieces.
add.whoA: A teammate Drax tries to save from Thanos on Knowhere.
add.whoB: Tells Thor she is Thanos's daughter. Struck down trying to save her.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
add.text: Drax and Gamora go with Quill to Ego's planet, where she grabs Mantis for answers, Drax tells her Mantis has told him everything, and they fight together to save Quill.
add.whoA: A teammate who joins Drax in saving Quill from Ego.
add.whoB: A teammate who joins Gamora in saving Quill from Ego.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Tony has F.R.I.D.A.Y. clear New York's streets as Thanos's ship arrives, and she patches Pepper's call through as he follows the ship into space.
add.whoA: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s boss, whose call from Pepper she relays as he leaves Earth.
add.whoB: Tony's A.I., who clears New York's streets and relays Pepper's call.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs Tony's armor through the airport battle and finds that the fake psychiatrist is Zemo. In Siberia, Tony has her analyze Steve's fight pattern so he can counter his blows.
add.whoA: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, who has her identify Zemo and read Steve's fighting.
add.whoB: Tony's A.I., who uncovers Zemo and scans Steve's fight pattern in Siberia.

add.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
add.text: When Tony sends an empty suit to pull Peter out of a lake, F.R.I.D.A.Y. takes over its controls once Tony ends the call and flies it away.
add.whoA: Scolds Peter through the empty suit, then hands it to F.R.I.D.A.Y.
add.whoB: Flies the empty suit away after Tony ends the call.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Groot swears at Quill over his game aboard the Benatar, Gamora and the rest of the crew react in shock.
add.whoA: A teenage teammate whose swearing shocks Gamora and the crew.
add.whoB: A teammate who reacts in shock when Groot swears at Quill.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Groot, flies in to pick up Quill and Groot after they leap from the rising Arête with Theel.
add.whoA: A Guardian Gamora picks up after he leaps from Arête.
add.whoB: A Ravager who picks Groot up after his leap from Arête.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Mantis goes with Gamora to Knowhere to stop Thanos, and Thanos strikes Mantis down as he takes Gamora captive.
add.whoA: Goes with Gamora to Knowhere. Struck down as Thanos takes her.
add.whoB: A teammate Thanos takes captive on Knowhere.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Mantis, stays with her on Counter-Earth to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks Mantis into going after Quill.
add.whoA: A Guardian who stays with Gamora to guard Rocket.
add.whoB: A Ravager Mantis guards Rocket with on Counter-Earth.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Rocket asks why the Guardians are answering a distress call, Gamora tells him someone could be dying, and the rescue brings them to Thor.
add.whoA: Asks why they answer the distress call. Gamora says someone could be dying.
add.whoB: Tells Rocket they answer the distress call because someone could be dying.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
add.text: Gamora leaves Rocket to guard Nebula and fix the ship, and when she tries to go back for Quill on Ego's planet, Rocket stuns her to keep her from dying in the blast.
add.whoA: Teammate who stuns Gamora to stop her dying for Quill.
add.whoB: Teammate Rocket stuns to keep her from going back for Quill.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Natasha and the others arrive at the Avengers compound, Rhodes cuts off Ross's order to arrest them and welcomes them back. They then fight side by side in Wakanda.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger Rhodes refuses to arrest, then fights beside in Wakanda.
add.whoB: Refuses Ross's order to arrest Natasha and fights beside her in Wakanda.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Rhodes and Natasha both sign the Sokovia Accords and fight on Tony's side at the Leipzig airport, where Rhodes is shot down.
add.whoA: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.
add.whoB: A fellow signer of the Accords, shot down on Tony's side at the airport.

add.title: Captain Marvel
add.text: After the Snap, Rhodey and Natasha keep watch over Fury's pager together at the Avengers compound.
add.whoA: A friend keeping watch over Fury's pager with Rhodes after the Snap.
add.whoB: A friend keeping watch over Fury's pager with Natasha after the Snap.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Sam and the others arrive at the Avengers compound, Rhodes cuts off Ross's order to arrest them and welcomes them back. They then fight on the same side in Wakanda.
add.whoA: Back on Rhodes's side. Rhodes refuses to arrest him and fights beside him in Wakanda.
add.whoB: Back on Sam's side. Refuses Ross's order to arrest him and fights beside him in Wakanda.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When the wounded Vision reaches the Avengers compound, Rhodes refuses Ross's order to arrest him and the others. Rhodes then fights in Wakanda to keep Thanos's army away from Vision while Shuri works on the Mind Stone.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger Rhodes shelters from Ross, then fights to protect in Wakanda.
add.whoB: Refuses Ross's order to arrest Vision, then fights to protect him in Wakanda.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Rhodes and Vision both join the new Avengers that Steve and Natasha train at the new base.
add.whoA: A fellow recruit in the new Avengers lineup.
add.whoB: A fellow recruit in the new Avengers lineup.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: As Thanos's army gathers outside the dome, M'Baku tells Okoye this will be the end of Wakanda, and she answers that it will be the noblest ending in history. They fight side by side in the battle that follows.
add.whoA: Tells M'Baku the coming battle will be the noblest ending in history.
add.whoB: Warns Okoye that the coming battle will be the end of Wakanda.

add.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
add.text: M'Baku trades insults with Okoye at Ramonda's council. When Talokan floods the city, Okoye tells him to pull Shuri away while she tries to revive Ramonda.
add.whoA: The general who trades insults with M'Baku and has him hold Shuri back.
add.whoB: The Jabari leader who trades insults with Okoye and holds Shuri back for her.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When T'Challa warns of the coming attack, M'Baku brings his Jabari warriors to defend Wakanda. T'Challa thanks him for coming, and they lead the charge against Thanos's army together.
add.whoA: The king who thanks M'Baku for bringing the Jabari to fight.
add.whoB: Brings the Jabari to defend Wakanda at T'Challa's call.

add.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
add.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and M'Baku mourns him at his funeral.
add.whoA: The king M'Baku mourns at his funeral.
add.whoB: The Jabari leader who mourns T'Challa at his funeral.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Hill is with Fury on a city street when people start turning to dust, and she fades away in front of him just before he sends a last signal.
add.whoA: Hill's boss and friend, who watches her turn to dust.
add.whoB: Fury's right hand, who turns to dust in front of him.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Hill helps Fury bring a hidden Helicarrier to Sokovia, and the two fight off a robot that crashes onto the bridge.
add.whoA: Hill's old boss, beside her on the Helicarrier bridge.
add.whoB: Fury's right hand, at his side on the Helicarrier bridge.

add.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
add.text: After Fury fakes his death, Hill keeps him hidden at a safehouse and brings Steve, Natasha and Sam to him. When they move against HYDRA, she takes control of the helicarriers so they destroy each other.
add.whoA: The boss Hill hides after his faked death.
add.whoB: Hides Fury after his faked death and turns the helicarriers on each other.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Steve and Natasha, still on the run together, rescue Wanda and Vision from Thanos's forces in Edinburgh, then fight side by side to defend Vision in Wakanda.
add.whoA: Rescues Wanda and Vision with Natasha in Edinburgh.
add.whoB: Fights beside Steve in Edinburgh and Wakanda.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Steve and Natasha take charge of the new Avengers together at the new base.
add.whoA: Natasha's close friend, leading the new Avengers with her.
add.whoB: Steve's close friend, leading the new Avengers with him.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Natasha signs the Sokovia Accords and comes to Peggy's funeral so Steve is not alone. At the Leipzig airport she lets him and Bucky escape rather than fight him.
add.whoA: A close friend Natasha comforts at Peggy's funeral and lets escape at the airport.
add.whoB: A close friend who comforts Steve at Peggy's funeral and lets him escape.

add.title: Captain Marvel
add.text: After the Snap, Natasha and Steve are at the Avengers compound together, trying to find out who Fury reached with his pager.
add.whoA: A close friend trying to trace Fury's pager with Natasha.
add.whoB: A close friend trying to trace Fury's pager with Steve.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Natasha, Steve and Sam bring Vision to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts them by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them, but Rhodes ends the call.
add.whoA: Orders Natasha's arrest when she returns to the Avengers Compound.
add.whoB: A fugitive Ross orders arrested at the Avengers Compound.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Sam flies with Steve and Natasha to rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, then fights under Steve's lead to defend Vision in Wakanda.
add.whoA: Leads Sam in the Edinburgh rescue and the fight for Wakanda.
add.whoB: Flies with Steve to rescue Wanda and Vision.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Sam joins the new Avengers that Steve trains at the new base.
add.whoA: Sam's close friend, who trains him with the new Avengers.
add.whoB: Steve's close friend and new recruit to the Avengers.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Sam refuses the Sokovia Accords and stands with Steve, helping him protect Bucky and fighting at his side at the Leipzig airport. Sam is locked in the Raft, and Steve breaks him out.
add.whoA: Sam's friend, who breaks him out of the Raft.
add.whoB: Steve's friend, who sides with him against the Accords.

add.title: Ant-Man
add.text: Steve Rogers and Sam Wilson hold Bucky Barnes but cannot call Tony Stark because of the Accords. When Steve fears they are on their own, Sam says he knows a guy who can help.
add.whoA: Sam's friend. Holds Bucky with Sam, unable to call Tony.
add.whoB: Steve's friend, who knows a guy who can help with Bucky.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Sam, Steve and Natasha bring Vision to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts them by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them, but Rhodes ends the call.
add.whoA: Orders Sam's arrest when he returns to the Avengers Compound.
add.whoB: A fugitive Ross orders arrested at the Avengers Compound.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Sam, Steve and Natasha rescue Wanda and Vision from Thanos's warriors in Edinburgh, and Sam fights beside her to defend Wakanda.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger Sam helps rescue in Edinburgh.
add.whoB: Helps rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Steve brings his team back to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts him by hologram and orders Rhodey to arrest them, but Steve says he is done asking permission.
add.whoA: Orders Steve's arrest at the Avengers Compound.
add.whoB: A fugitive Avenger Ross orders arrested.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Thor arrives in the battle for Wakanda with a new axe, and he and Steve catch up mid-fight, Steve noting Thor's new haircut and Thor noting Steve's beard.
add.whoA: An old teammate who turns the tide in Wakanda.
add.whoB: An old teammate who greets Thor in Wakanda.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: At the Avengers' party Steve budges Thor's hammer Mjolnir, to Thor's alarm, and the two fight Ultron's army side by side in Sokovia.
add.whoA: A teammate, alarmed when Steve budges Mjolnir at a party.
add.whoB: A teammate who budges Mjolnir at the Avengers' party.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Steve leads the rescue of Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh and takes them to Wakanda to protect the Mind Stone.
add.whoA: An ally Steve rescues in Edinburgh and shelters in Wakanda.
add.whoB: Rescues Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: When Wanda arrives at the Avengers Compound with Steve's team, Ross orders them all arrested before Rhodey cuts him off.
add.whoA: An Avenger Ross orders arrested at the compound.
add.whoB: Orders Wanda's arrest at the compound.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Groot and Mantis are aboard the Benatar with the Guardians when they pull Thor from the wreckage of the Asgardian ship. The team then splits, and Groot leaves with Rocket and Thor while Mantis heads to Knowhere.
add.whoA: A teammate on the Benatar who heads to Knowhere as Groot leaves with Thor.
add.whoB: A teammate on the Benatar who leaves with Rocket and Thor.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Groot and Mantis fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, then watch the God Butcher distress calls together on the Benatar before the team says goodbye to Thor.
add.whoA: A teammate on Indigarr and the Benatar.
add.whoB: A teammate on Indigarr and the Benatar.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: At the Christmas party, Groot gives Mantis a wood carving he made of her listening to Kraglin's story.
add.whoA: A teammate who gets one of Groot's Christmas carvings.
add.whoB: A teammate who gives Mantis a carving for Christmas.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: When the Avengers storm the Sokovia base, Dr. List urges Strucker to send out the twins. Strucker calls it too soon, then tells List he will surrender.
add.whoA: Strucker's HYDRA scientist, who urges him to send out the twins.
add.whoB: List's HYDRA boss, who plans to surrender as the Avengers storm the base.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Fury waits for the team at the Barton farm and pushes them to plan against Ultron, and Bruce works out that Ultron's next move is a new body from Helen Cho.
add.whoA: The old spymaster who rallies Bruce and the team at the farm.
add.whoB: A scientist who works out Ultron's next move as Fury rallies the team.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: After Johannesburg, Hill calls Clint on the Quinjet and tells the team to lie low, and Clint takes them to his farm.
add.whoA: The officer who calls Clint and tells the team to lie low.
add.whoB: An agent Hill calls on the Quinjet, who knows a place to hide.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Clint hides the team at his secret family farm, where his children greet Natasha as Auntie Nat.
add.whoA: Clint's best friend, already part of his secret family.
add.whoB: Natasha's best friend, whose children call her Auntie Nat.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Clint and Natasha fight on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport. Mid-fight she asks if they are still friends, and he jokes that it depends on how hard she hits him.
add.whoA: Clint's best friend, fought on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport.
add.whoB: Natasha's best friend, who fights her at the airport but jokes they're still friends.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Clint hides Tony and the rest of the team at his secret family farm after Johannesburg.
add.whoA: A teammate Clint shelters at his secret farm.
add.whoB: A teammate who shelters Tony at his secret family farm.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Thor seeks out Selvig in England for help understanding his vision, and Selvig goes with him to the Water of Sight.
add.whoA: A friend Selvig helps make sense of his vision.
add.whoB: An old friend Thor turns to for help with his vision.

add.title: The Avengers
add.text: Freed from Loki's control after the battle, Selvig hands his friend Thor the Tesseract to take back to Asgard, and Thor touches his shoulder in farewell.
add.whoA: Friend who takes the Tesseract from Selvig back to Asgard.
add.whoB: Friend, freed from Loki's control, who hands Thor the Tesseract.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: Selvig greets Thor in London and helps him find where Malekith will strike. At Greenwich, Selvig's devices let Thor stop Malekith, and his last one saves Thor from the falling Dark Elf ship.
add.whoA: Friend who uses Selvig's devices to stop Malekith.
add.whoB: Scientist whose device saves Thor from Malekith's falling ship.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Rhodey flies in as War Machine from Fury's Helicarrier and fights Ultron's drones over Sokovia beside Tony.
add.whoA: Rhodes's best friend, fighting beside him over Sokovia.
add.whoB: Tony's best friend, who flies in as War Machine over Sokovia.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: Tony and Rhodey team up to stop Killian, saving the President and fighting side by side on the oil rig.
add.whoA: Rhodes's best friend, who fights Killian beside him.
add.whoB: Tony's best friend, who saves the President while Tony fights Killian.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Hill backs the Avengers at their tower, and when Ultron attacks the team's party, she and Natasha both open fire on his robots.
add.whoA: An Avenger Hill backs at the tower. Fights off Ultron's robots at the party.
add.whoB: Backs the Avengers at the tower. Fights off Ultron's robots at the party.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: At the new compound Fury tells Natasha where the Hulk's Quinjet was last seen, and she asks whether he planned for her and Bruce to fall for each other.
add.whoA: A trusted friend who tells Natasha where the Hulk's Quinjet went.
add.whoB: A trusted friend who asks Fury about her and Bruce.

add.title: The Avengers
add.text: For Fury's Avengers Initiative, Natasha brings Bruce Banner in from Kolkata, then works under Fury on the Helicarrier in the hunt for Loki.
add.whoA: Natasha's director, whose initiative she recruits Banner for.
add.whoB: Agent who brings Banner in for Fury's initiative.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Sam joins the new Avengers that Natasha and Steve train at the new base.
add.whoA: A friend and new recruit Natasha trains.
add.whoB: A friend who trains Sam with the new Avengers.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: When Natasha backs the Sokovia Accords, Sam asks if she is the same woman who once told the government off. They end up on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport.
add.whoA: A friend who questions Natasha's support for the Accords.
add.whoB: A friend who backs the Accords while Sam refuses them.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: At the Barton farm, Natasha needles Tony over his failure to save the world as Fury rallies the team.
add.whoA: A teammate Natasha needles over his failure at the farm.
add.whoB: A teammate who needles Tony at the farm over his failure.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Natasha sides with Tony on the Sokovia Accords and fights on his team at the Leipzig airport. After she lets Steve and Bucky go, they argue and he warns her that Ross is coming for her.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger Natasha backs on the Accords, then crosses at the airport.
add.whoB: A fellow Avenger who backs Tony on the Accords, then lets Steve go.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Fury brings a hidden Helicarrier to Sokovia so Steve can get the city's people out.
add.whoA: The Captain whose rescue Fury makes possible with a Helicarrier.
add.whoB: Steve's old boss, who brings a Helicarrier to save Sokovia's people.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Fury waits at the Barton farm and talks Tony back on track after Wanda's vision, telling him he can fight hate and war.
add.whoA: A founding Avenger Fury talks back on track at the farm.
add.whoB: The old spymaster who steadies Tony at the farm.

add.title: Iron Man 2
add.text: Fury reveals Natalie Rushman is his agent, helps slow Tony's palladium poisoning and hands him his father's old materials. Afterward he keeps Tony on only as a consultant.
add.whoA: The man Fury helps with his father's notes, kept on only as a consultant.
add.whoB: The director who helps Tony with his father's notes, then keeps him as a consultant.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Steve clashes with Tony over building Ultron and over giving J.A.R.V.I.S. a new body, but they fight side by side in Sokovia and part warmly at the new Avengers base.
add.whoA: A teammate Steve clashes with over Ultron, then fights beside in Sokovia.
add.whoB: A teammate who clashes with Tony over Ultron, then fights beside him in Sokovia.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Thor grabs Tony by the throat after Ultron, the program Tony built, attacks the team. In Sokovia they overload Ultron's machine together and shatter the falling city.
add.whoA: The builder of Ultron. Overloads Ultron's machine alongside Thor.
add.whoB: A teammate who grabs Tony by the throat over Ultron.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: At the Avengers' party Natasha passes on trying to lift Thor's hammer, and they fight Ultron as teammates from Johannesburg to Sokovia.
add.whoA: A teammate who passes on trying to lift Thor's hammer.
add.whoB: A teammate whose hammer Natasha passes on trying to lift.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: After Bruce's rampage as the Hulk in Johannesburg, Clint hides him and the rest of the team at his secret family farmhouse.
add.whoA: A teammate who hides Bruce at his family's farmhouse.
add.whoB: A teammate Clint hides at his farmhouse after the Hulk's rampage.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Selvig reviews the test results Jane sends him as she fights stage four cancer, and on a video call he tells her the chemo is still not working.
add.whoA: His protégée, whose cancer test results he reviews.
add.whoB: Her mentor, who reviews her test results and tells her the chemo is failing.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: Selvig reunites with Jane in London and works out that the Convergence will peak at Greenwich. There his last device sends Malekith's falling ship away from her and Thor.
add.whoA: Protégée Selvig saves from Malekith's falling ship at Greenwich.
add.whoB: Mentor whose last device saves Jane from Malekith's falling ship.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Thor answers Sif's distress call and finds her wounded on Alfheim with her arm cut off. She warns him that Gorr will strike New Asgard next, and he takes her home with him.
add.whoA: Her old friend, who answers her distress call and takes her home.
add.whoB: His old friend, found wounded after hunting Gorr. Warns him New Asgard is next.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: Sif saves Thor from a missile on Vanaheim and quietly hopes to rekindle his feelings for her. Later she frees Jane from her cell so Thor can take her off Asgard.
add.whoA: Old friend whose life Sif saves on Vanaheim.
add.whoB: Old friend who saves Thor's life and frees Jane for him.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: On Indigarr, Rocket snaps at Thor for promising the mission would be a relaxing holiday. When Thor leaves to help Sif, he says goodbye to Rocket.
add.whoA: A teammate Rocket snaps at over the promised holiday. Says goodbye when he leaves.
add.whoB: A Guardian who snaps at Thor over the so-called holiday.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Kraglin keeps watch over the Benatar while Nebula and the Guardians fight on Indigarr, then surprises the team by bringing aboard Glenda, the Indigarrian he married.
add.whoA: A teammate Kraglin surprises with his new wife.
add.whoB: The Guardians' pilot, who comes back from Indigarr married.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: When Kraglin brings up Christmas, Nebula says they have no time for it while they rebuild Knowhere, and the two go back to the repairs.
add.whoA: A fellow Guardian who brushes off Christmas to keep rebuilding Knowhere.
add.whoB: A fellow Guardian whose talk of Christmas Nebula brushes off.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Kraglin's misfired arrow stabs Nebula on Knowhere, and later she radios him to lock Knowhere onto Arête so everyone can escape.
add.whoA: A teammate Kraglin stabs by mistake, who later radios him for the escape.
add.whoB: A teammate whose arrow stabs Nebula, who locks Knowhere on for the escape.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Kraglin shows the team Glenda, the Indigarrian he married while the others fought, and Quill scolds him for marrying on every planet they land on. Later Kraglin goes to start the ship while Quill talks with Thor.
add.whoA: The Guardians' leader, who scolds Kraglin for marrying.
add.whoB: The Guardians' pilot, scolded by Quill for marrying on Indigarr.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: Kraglin remembers young Quill teaching him about Christmas aboard the Ravager ship. When the team kidnaps Kevin Bacon, Quill has Kraglin ready the ship to take him home, and Kraglin tells Bacon how much he means to Quill.
add.whoA: The boy who taught Kraglin Christmas, now a friend who sends him to fly Bacon home.
add.whoB: An old Ravager friend who helped him celebrate Christmas as a boy.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Quill leaves Kraglin in charge of Knowhere, then calls him to fly it to Arête and blast an opening for the rescue.
add.whoA: A friend who leaves Kraglin in charge and calls him in for the rescue.
add.whoB: A friend Quill leaves in charge of Knowhere and calls in for the rescue.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Kraglin keeps watch over the Benatar while Rocket and the Guardians fight on Indigarr, then surprises the team by bringing aboard Glenda, the Indigarrian he married.
add.whoA: A teammate Kraglin surprises with his new wife.
add.whoB: The Guardians' pilot, who comes back from Indigarr married.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: Kraglin and Rocket are fellow Guardians on Knowhere, and both are there when the team surprises Quill with a Christmas party.
add.whoA: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
add.whoB: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
add.text: Rocket threatens to blow up the Ravagers' ship until Quill tells him they have already struck a deal. Over Xandar, Kraglin blasts a hole in Ronan's ship while Rocket fires beside him.
add.whoA: A bounty hunter who threatens the Ravagers' ship, then fights beside Kraglin over Xandar.
add.whoB: Yondu's first mate, who blasts open Ronan's ship beside Rocket.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Kraglin keeps watch over the Benatar while Mantis and the Guardians fight on Indigarr, then surprises the team by bringing aboard Glenda, the Indigarrian he married.
add.whoA: A teammate Kraglin surprises with his new wife.
add.whoB: The Guardians' pilot, who comes back from Indigarr married.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Mantis captive aboard Arête, Kraglin flies Knowhere in and blasts a way into the ship for the rescue.
add.whoA: A teammate Kraglin flies Knowhere in to rescue.
add.whoB: A teammate who flies Knowhere in to rescue Mantis.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Nebula and Rocket fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, then argue over Thor's goats on the Benatar before saying goodbye to him.
add.whoA: A teammate on Indigarr who joins the goat argument.
add.whoB: A teammate on Indigarr who joins the goat argument.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: At the Christmas party on Knowhere, Nebula drops a wrapped present at Rocket's feet: Bucky's prosthetic arm.
add.whoA: A teammate Nebula gives Bucky's arm as a Christmas present.
add.whoB: A teammate who gives Rocket Bucky's arm as a Christmas present.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Thor travels and trains with the Guardians, and stops Nebula when she tries to kill the screaming goats he brings aboard the Benatar. The team parts ways with him when he leaves to answer Sif's call.
add.whoA: A Guardians teammate who tries to kill the goats Thor brings aboard.
add.whoB: A teammate who stops Nebula killing his goats, then leaves to help Sif.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Drax fights beside Thor on the Guardians' missions and defends the goats Thor brings aboard the Benatar when the others want them gone. The team parts ways with Thor when he leaves to answer Sif's call.
add.whoA: A Guardians teammate who loves the goats Thor brings aboard.
add.whoB: A teammate who brings goats aboard, then leaves to help Sif.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: In the New Asgard town hall, Miek writes Thor's rescue plan on a whiteboard as he speaks. Thor asks her to stop the noise, then has her write down his last point.
add.whoA: Korg's friend. Writes up Thor's rescue plan in the town hall.
add.whoB: A friend whose rescue speech Miek writes on the whiteboard.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Miek works as Valkyrie's secretary in New Asgard and helps her open the town's new businesses. After Gorr's attack, Valkyrie orders her to find out which children have been taken.
add.whoA: Her secretary in New Asgard. Tracks down the families of the taken children.
add.whoB: The king Miek works for as secretary.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Kraglin returns to the Benatar with Glenda, a new wife he married while keeping watch on Indigarr, catching Groot by surprise.
add.whoA: A fellow Guardian who comes back from Indigarr with a new wife.
add.whoB: A teammate surprised by Kraglin's new wife.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: Groot gives Kraglin a wood carving of Kraglin opening that very present, and Kraglin tells Kevin Bacon that Groot is just a kid.
add.whoA: A fellow Guardian who calls Groot just a kid.
add.whoB: A fellow Guardian who gives Kraglin a carving for Christmas.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Logan wakes in a changed future and finds Scott alive at the school. Scott warns him off Jean, and Logan tells him it's good to see him.
add.whoA: Alive again in the changed future. Warns Logan off Jean.
add.whoB: Tells Scott it's good to see him, to Scott's confusion.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Storm arrives at the temple with Logan and fights the Sentinels to protect the X-Men while his mind is in the past, and she is killed there.
add.whoA: Holds off the Sentinels while Logan's mind is in the past.
add.whoB: Arrives at the temple with Storm, then goes back to 1973.

add.title: X2
add.text: Storm calls Logan in Boston and flies the X-Jet in to pick him and the students up after the police standoff.
add.whoA: Picks Logan up in the X-Jet in Boston.
add.whoB: Picked up by Storm in Boston.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Bobby is among the last X-Men who hold off the Sentinels at the temple while Logan's mind is in the past, and he is killed there.
add.whoA: One of the last X-Men defending the temple.
add.whoB: The X-Man whose trip to 1973 Bobby fights to protect.

add.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
add.text: When Bobby reminds Logan there are only six of them left, Logan rallies him to fight Magneto at Alcatraz. There Logan asks Bobby to take down Pyro, and Bobby goes after him.
add.whoA: Answers Logan's call to fight, and takes on Pyro for him.
add.whoB: Rallies Bobby to fight and sends him after Pyro.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Colossus is among the last X-Men who hold off the Sentinels at the temple while Logan's mind is in the past, and he is killed there.
add.whoA: One of the last X-Men defending the temple.
add.whoB: The X-Man whose trip to 1973 Colossus fights to protect.

add.title: X2
add.text: During Stryker's raid on the school, Colossus offers to help Logan fight, but Logan tells him to help the other students, and Colossus leads them to safety.
add.whoA: Leads the students out of the raid at Logan's word.
add.whoB: Sends Colossus to get the students out during the raid.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: In 1973 Logan finds Hank looking after the closed school, and Hank joins his mission to stop Raven, from Erik's breakout to Paris and Washington.
add.whoA: Joins Logan's 1973 mission to stop Raven.
add.whoB: A stranger from the future whose mission Hank joins.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Storm arrives at the temple with Xavier and dies holding off the Sentinels while his plan to send Logan's mind to the past plays out.
add.whoA: Dies defending the temple during Xavier's plan.
add.whoB: The mentor whose last plan Storm fights for.

add.title: X2
add.text: Storm has Nightcrawler take her into Stryker's Cerebro, where she freezes the room to break Jason's hold and free Xavier.
add.whoA: Freezes Stryker's Cerebro to free Xavier.
add.whoB: Freed by Storm from Stryker's Cerebro.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: In 1973 Hank looks after the broken Charles at the closed school and makes the serum that lets him walk, then helps him find Raven.
add.whoA: Looks after Charles and makes his serum.
add.whoB: The broken friend Hank looks after in 1973.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Hank helps free Erik from the Pentagon, but in Paris he fights Erik to stop him from killing Raven.
add.whoA: Fights Erik in Paris to save Raven.
add.whoB: Freed from the Pentagon, then fought by Hank in Paris.

add.title: X-Men: First Class
add.text: Erik and Hank train together on Charles's team to stop Shaw, but Erik talks Raven out of the cure Hank makes. At Cuba Erik breaks away and leaves, while Hank stays with Charles.
add.whoA: A teammate on Charles's first team, whose cure Erik talks Raven out of.
add.whoB: A teammate who talks Raven out of Hank's cure, then leaves at Cuba.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Bobby fights the Sentinels in Moscow to buy Kitty time, and later dies defending the temple while she keeps Logan's mind in the past.
add.whoA: Fights to buy Kitty time in Moscow and at the temple.
add.whoB: The friend Bobby fights to protect.

add.title: X2
add.text: Logan returns to Xavier's school wanting more about his past. Xavier tells him he must find some answers for himself and leaves him to watch the students.
add.whoA: Tells Logan to find some answers himself.
add.whoB: Back at Xavier's school, left to watch the students.

add.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
add.text: Logan clashes with Xavier over the blocks Xavier placed in Jean's mind, then follows him into her childhood home, where Jean destroys him before Logan's eyes.
add.whoA: Clashes with Logan over Jean's mind, and dies in front of him.
add.whoB: Challenges Xavier over Jean, then watches him die.

add.title: X-Men: First Class
add.text: Charles and Erik walk up to Logan in a bar to recruit him, and Logan swears at them and sends them off.
add.whoA: Tries to recruit Logan in a bar and is sworn at.
add.whoB: A loner in a bar who swears off Charles's recruiting pitch.

add.title: The Wolverine
add.text: Two years after Japan, Xavier, long believed dead, reveals himself to Logan at an airport and backs Magneto's warning about a weapon that could end the mutant race.
add.whoA: Believed dead, returns to warn Logan of a threat to all mutants.
add.whoB: The X-Man Xavier comes back to warn of a threat to all mutants.

add.title: X2
add.text: Logan gets Rogue out of the school during Stryker's raid and keeps her with him on the run to Boston.
add.whoA: Flees the raid on the school with Logan.
add.whoB: Gets Rogue out of the school during the raid.

add.title: X2
add.text: Charles visits Erik in his plastic prison, where Erik admits he told Stryker everything about Cerebro. Later Erik turns Stryker's Cerebro so the captive Charles will kill every human.
add.whoA: Gives Charles's secrets to Stryker, then turns him on humanity.
add.whoB: Used by Magneto to try to kill every human.

add.title: The Wolverine
add.text: Charles, long believed dead, is working alongside Erik again, and the two come to Logan together to warn him of a threat to all mutants.
add.whoA: Charles's old rival, working beside him again.
add.whoB: Believed dead, turns up working beside Erik again.

add.title: X2
add.text: Xavier takes Scott with him to question Magneto, and Stryker's people capture them both at the prison.
add.whoA: Goes with Xavier to see Magneto and is captured with him.
add.whoB: Taken captive with Scott at Magneto's prison.

add.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
add.text: While Scott grieves for Jean, Xavier worries he is a changed man. When Scott meets Jean at Alkali Lake, Xavier senses his distress and sends Logan and Storm after him.
add.whoA: The grieving student whose distress Xavier senses at Alkali Lake.
add.whoB: Senses Scott's distress and sends help.

add.title: X-Men (2000)
add.text: Scott leads Xavier's X-Men, bringing Logan and Rogue to the school. When Xavier falls into a coma, Scott thanks him for all he has done and takes the team to Liberty Island.
add.whoA: Leads Xavier's X-Men and watches over him in his coma.
add.whoB: Scott's teacher, who sends him and his X-Men out.

add.title: X2
add.text: As Jean holds back the flood at Alkali Lake, she speaks her goodbye to the team through Xavier's mind.
add.whoA: Says goodbye to the team through Xavier's mind.
add.whoB: The mentor Jean speaks through as she says goodbye.

add.title: X2
add.text: Rogue goes with Xavier's X-Men to the White House and hands the President Stryker's files while Xavier warns him.
add.whoA: Hands the President Stryker's files beside Xavier.
add.whoB: Leads Rogue and the X-Men to the White House.

add.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
add.text: When Rogue bursts in to ask whether mutants can really be cured, Xavier admits it appears to be true.
add.whoA: A student who asks Xavier if the cure is real.
add.whoB: Admits to Rogue the cure seems real.

add.title: X2
add.text: Mystique poisons a guard with iron so Magneto can break out of his plastic prison. Together they turn Stryker's Cerebro on humans and escape in his helicopter.
add.whoA: Frees Magneto from his plastic prison.
add.whoB: The leader Mystique breaks out of prison.

add.title: X2
add.text: On the flight to Alkali Lake, Magneto taunts Rogue about the white streak in her hair, a reminder of how he nearly killed her.
add.whoA: Taunted by Magneto over the streak in her hair.
add.whoB: Taunts Rogue about the night he nearly killed her.

add.title: X2
add.text: Jean reads Nightcrawler's mind to find Stryker's base for Magneto's plan, then goes in with him to keep an eye on him and holds off a brainwashed Cyclops so he can reach Cerebro.
add.whoA: Joins Magneto's raid to keep an eye on him.
add.whoB: Works with Jean to stop Stryker.

add.title: X-Men (2000)
add.text: At the top of the Statue of Liberty, Magneto binds Jean and the other X-Men in metal. Jean tells him Senator Kelly is dead, but he ignores her and goes on with his plan.
add.whoA: An X-Man Magneto binds in metal at the Statue of Liberty.
add.whoB: Binds Jean in metal at the Statue of Liberty.

add.title: X2
add.text: Inside the Alkali Lake dam, a brainwashed Scott aims a blast at Magneto and Mystique from a crossing hallway. Jean shoves them clear and tells them to go, and Magneto leaves her to fight Scott.
add.whoA: Scott, under Stryker's control, aims a blast at him in the dam.
add.whoB: Aims a blast at Magneto in the dam while under Stryker's control.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
add.text: After Daisy frees her from Ramon in Baltimore, the two erase every record of Yo-Yo's trip from S.H.I.E.L.D.'s system. Yo-Yo tells Daisy she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy Carter's old pin as a reminder that she is part of the team.
add.whoA: A fellow Inhuman who keeps Daisy's secret and gives her Peggy Carter's pin.
add.whoB: A fellow Inhuman who saves Yo-Yo in Baltimore and helps erase her trip.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
add.text: Jemma checks Yo-Yo's pulse while finishing her Inhuman registration, and Yo-Yo knocks over lab equipment and talks up apartment hunting to keep her from seeing the search on the lab computer.
add.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who registers Yo-Yo, kept from seeing her search.
add.whoB: Inhuman Jemma registers, who distracts her to hide a search for Ramon.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
add.text: Fitz upgrades Yo-Yo's watch so S.H.I.E.L.D. can monitor her powers and scolds her for getting Jemma hooked on apartment hunting, unaware she is using the lab computer to find Ramon.
add.whoA: Engineer who upgrades Yo-Yo's watch to monitor her powers.
add.whoB: Inhuman whose watch Fitz upgrades, who hides a search from him.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
add.text: May works out that Yo-Yo stole Mace's lanyard, takes it back and scolds her for sloppy spy work, then keeps quiet and quietly sends her Quinjet to Baltimore.
add.whoA: Friend who catches Yo-Yo's theft, keeps quiet and sends her to Baltimore.
add.whoB: Friend May catches stealing Mace's lanyard and quietly sends to Baltimore.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
add.text: On his way out after stepping down as Director, Coulson urges Yo-Yo to give Mace a chance and gives her a pin that belonged to Peggy Carter, so she remembers she is part of a team.

add.title: Iron Man 2
add.text: In Monaco, Christine Everhart is interviewing Justin Hammer and tries to make Tony jealous, but he shrugs her off by bringing up their night together. She then presses him about his ties to Hammer.
add.whoA: A billionaire who shrugs off Christine's jabs in Monaco.
add.whoB: A reporter who needles Tony in Monaco while interviewing Hammer.

add.title: Iron Man 2
add.text: In Monaco, Christine Everhart asks Pepper for a quote on her new job running Stark Industries, and Pepper mocks her past story on Tony.
add.whoA: A reporter who asks Pepper for a quote in Monaco.
add.whoB: The new Stark Industries CEO who mocks Christine in Monaco.

add.title: Iron Man 2
add.text: Tony has Dum-E help him synthesize his father's new element, then sets the robot to cleaning up the mess.
add.whoA: The creator who has Dum-E help make a new element.
add.whoB: Workshop robots that help Tony make his new element.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: Tony makes Dum-E wear a dunce cap after a clumsy suit test, and after his house is destroyed he digs the wrecked robots out of the rubble and takes them with him.
add.whoA: Gives Dum-E a dunce cap, then saves the robots from the ruins.
add.whoB: Tony's robots, pulled from the ruins of his house.

add.title: Iron Man 2
add.text: Pepper points Rhodes to Tony, hoping he can rein him in, and the two talk over Tony's drunken behavior at his birthday party.
add.whoA: A friend who sends Rhodes to talk sense into Tony.
add.whoB: A friend Pepper turns to when Tony spirals.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: Rhodey and Pepper stand together at Tony's side as he goes in for surgery to remove the shrapnel near his heart.
add.whoA: A friend at Tony's surgery with Rhodes.
add.whoB: A friend at Tony's surgery with Pepper.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: At a New Year's Eve party in Bern in 1999, Yinsen introduces himself to a drunk Tony, who brushes him off with a joke about his name.
add.whoA: A drunk Tony who brushes Yinsen off at a party in Bern.
add.whoB: A scientist Tony brushes off at a party in Bern.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: When helicopters attack the mansion, Tony's Mark 42 armor, run by J.A.R.V.I.S., closes around Pepper, and she uses it to save Tony and Maya Hansen.
add.whoA: Tony's AI, whose armor shields Pepper during the attack.
add.whoB: Wears the armor J.A.R.V.I.S. runs to escape the attack.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
add.text: Kraglin flies the Ravager ship down to Ego's crumbling planet and carries Gamora and the others away before it explodes.
add.whoA: Ravager who flies Gamora off Ego's planet before it explodes.
add.whoB: A Guardian Kraglin flies off Ego's planet.

add.title: Thor: Ragnarok
add.text: Strange pulls Thor into the Sanctum, tells him where Odin is, and sends him and Loki to Norway to find their father.
add.whoA: The sorcerer who sends Thor and Loki to Odin in Norway.
add.whoB: Strange sends him and Loki to find Odin in Norway.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: Dopinder comes to Wade's surprise birthday party and tells him a story about AirPods left in his cab. He joins Wade's friends again for dinner once the danger is over.
add.whoA: The cabbie at Wade's birthday party.
add.whoB: The friend whose birthday party Dopinder attends.

add.title: Deadpool 2
add.text: Dopinder begs Wade for a place in his line of work and drives him, Domino and Cable to the orphanage. He runs over the abusive headmaster there, to Wade's approval.
add.whoA: Drives Wade to the orphanage. Runs over the headmaster.
add.whoB: The hero Dopinder drives to the orphanage.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: Wade lives with Al again, and at his birthday party she nags him about the rent and offers him cocaine. After the fight with the Deadpool Corps, he brings Logan and Dogpool home to meet her.
add.whoA: Wade's roommate again. Nags him about the rent.
add.whoB: Al's roommate again. Brings Logan and Dogpool home.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: Colossus comes to Wade's surprise birthday party, and the two chat about what he's watching on TV.
add.whoA: An X-Man and guest at Wade's birthday party.
add.whoB: The friend whose birthday party Colossus attends.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: At Wade's surprise birthday party, Negasonic teases him about his obvious toupee.
add.whoA: Teases Wade about his toupee at his party.
add.whoB: The friend Negasonic teases about his toupee.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: Yukio comes to Wade's surprise birthday party with Negasonic and tells him she likes his toupee.
add.whoA: Negasonic's girlfriend. Likes Wade's toupee.
add.whoB: The friend whose toupee Yukio likes.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: Buck comes to Wade's surprise birthday party, and Wade cuts him off every time he tries to speak.
add.whoA: A biker pal at Wade's birthday party.
add.whoB: The friend who keeps cutting Buck off.

add.title: Deadpool 2
add.text: Weasel tries to comfort the grieving Wade at Sister Margaret's, then helps him hold auditions to build X-Force.
add.whoA: Helps Wade audition recruits for X-Force.
add.whoB: The grieving friend Weasel helps build X-Force.

add.title: Deadpool 2
add.text: Colossus takes Negasonic, now in full X-Men uniform, and his new trainee Wade to answer the standoff at the orphanage.
add.whoA: Joins Colossus at the orphanage standoff.
add.whoB: Leads Negasonic on the orphanage call.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: Charles sends Peter with the X-Men to rescue the Endeavour crew in space, and Peter speeds the astronauts out of the breaking shuttle.
add.whoA: Speeds the astronauts out on Charles's space rescue.
add.whoB: Sends Peter's team to rescue the astronauts.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: Scott learns Charles hid the truth about Jean's past from her, but he stands with Charles on the train to convince the others that Jean can still be saved.
add.whoA: Stands with Charles to save Jean.
add.whoB: Hid Jean's past, then fights beside Scott to save her.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Charles sends the X-Men on, and after Raven's death she stays with Charles and goes with him to New York to save Jean.
add.whoA: Stays with Charles and helps him save Jean.
add.whoB: Leads Ororo's team to save Jean.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: When Charles learns Erik means to kill Jean, Kurt teleports him and the X-Men to New York to save her.
add.whoA: Teleports Charles to New York to save Jean.
add.whoB: Kurt's teacher, whom he takes to New York to save Jean.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: Raven leads Kurt on the space rescue, sending him into the breaking shuttle to teleport the astronauts out.
add.whoA: Teleports the astronauts out on Raven's rescue.
add.whoB: Leads Kurt on the space rescue.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Raven leads, then joins her and the X-Men at Jean's hometown to bring Jean home.
add.whoA: On Raven's team in space and at Jean's home.
add.whoB: Leads Ororo's team in space, then goes with her to Jean's home.

add.title: Dark Phoenix
add.text: On the space rescue Scott blasts a hole in the shuttle so Kurt can teleport in, and later Kurt teleports him to New York to save Jean.
add.whoA: Teleports Scott to New York to save Jean.
add.whoB: Blasts open the shuttle for Kurt.

add.title: Black Panther
add.text: Ayo stands guard by Shuri at the coronation, raising her spear when M'Baku closes in on her, and later fights beside her against the Border Tribe.
add.whoA: The princess Ayo guards and fights beside.
add.whoB: Guards Shuri and fights beside her.

add.title: Black Panther
add.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje guarding the royal family. When Killmonger takes the throne, she stays to serve it rather than flee with Ramonda and Shuri.
add.whoA: The queen mother Okoye stays behind rather than flee with.
add.whoB: The general who stays to serve the throne under Killmonger.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Pulled into the Quantum Realm with Scott and his family, Hank is saved by his evolved ants and helps Scott and Hope fight their way to Kang.
add.whoA: Fights through the Quantum Realm with Hank to reach Kang.
add.whoB: Brings his ants to help Scott reach Kang.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Janet is pulled into the Quantum Realm with Scott and his family, where Scott learns her past with Kang helped him rise. In the end she fixes Kang's power core so the family can get home.
add.whoA: Learns Janet's past with Kang.
add.whoB: Fixes the power core that gets Scott's family home.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Jimmy and Scott have lunch together, and Scott pulls a card trick with Jimmy's card. Passers-by who recognize Ant-Man pay their bill.
add.whoA: The friend who pulls a card trick on Jimmy over lunch.
add.whoB: Has lunch with Scott and falls for another card trick.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Loki and Mobius watch Victor Timely, another variant of Kang, present his inventions at the 1893 Chicago World's Fair.
add.whoA: Spots Victor Timely with Loki at the fair.
add.whoB: Watches Victor Timely with Mobius at the fair.

add.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
add.text: Sabretooth helps Stryker capture a teenage Scott Summers, who is locked in Stryker's island prison.
add.whoA: Helps Stryker capture Scott as a teenager.
add.whoB: A teenage mutant Sabretooth helps Stryker capture.

add.title: X-Men: First Class
add.text: Erik and Charles walk up to Logan in a bar to recruit him, and Logan swears at them and sends them off.
add.whoA: Tries to recruit Logan in a bar alongside Charles.
add.whoB: A loner in a bar who swears off Erik's recruiting pitch.

add.title: The Wolverine
add.text: Magneto approaches Logan at an airport and warns him that humans are building a weapon that would end the mutant race. Logan does not believe him until Xavier appears at Magneto's side.
add.whoA: Warns Logan of a weapon built to end the mutant race.
add.whoB: An X-Man Magneto warns of a weapon built to end the mutant race.

add.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
add.text: Peter B. and Spider-Man Noir answer Gwen's call and join her new team to rescue Miles.
add.whoA: Joins Gwen's team with Peter B. to rescue Miles.
add.whoB: Joins Gwen's team with Spider-Man Noir to rescue Miles.

add.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
add.text: Peter B. and Peni answer Gwen's call and join her new team to rescue Miles.
add.whoA: Joins Gwen's team with Peter B. to rescue Miles.
add.whoB: Joins Gwen's team with Peni to rescue Miles.

add.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
add.text: Peter B. and Spider-Ham answer Gwen's call and join her new team to rescue Miles.
add.whoA: Joins Gwen's team with Peter B. to rescue Miles.
add.whoB: Joins Gwen's team with Spider-Ham to rescue Miles.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Fury stays in contact with Carol as she checks the broken jump point, and on S.A.B.E.R. he shows her his plan to evacuate the crew inside Goose's kittens.
add.whoA: Talks with Carol from S.A.B.E.R. and evacuates the station with Goose's kittens.
add.whoB: Checks in with Fury from the jump point and helps evacuate S.A.B.E.R.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Fury looks after Goose on S.A.B.E.R. while the Marvels are away, and when she gives birth he uses her kittens to swallow the crew and evacuate the station.
add.whoA: Minds Goose on S.A.B.E.R. and evacuates the crew inside her kittens.
add.whoB: Has kittens on S.A.B.E.R., which Fury uses to evacuate the crew.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Kate comes home to her new apartment and gives Lucky a slice of pizza as Kamala introduces herself.
add.whoA: Gets a slice of pizza from Kate at her new apartment.
add.whoB: Feeds Lucky pizza at her new apartment.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: In the Kree attack on the Khan home, Goose saves Monica by swallowing the chair she falls onto. Monica later pets her while explaining the switching to the Khans.
add.whoA: Saves Monica in the fight at the Khan home.
add.whoB: Saved by Goose in the fight at the Khan home.

add.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
add.text: Reed agrees to a bachelor party for Ben's sake before his wedding to Sue, and the two later fight side by side against the Surfer and Doom.
add.whoA: Wants Reed to have a bachelor party. Fights the Surfer and Doom beside him.
add.whoB: Ben's best friend, who agrees to a bachelor party for his sake.

add.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
add.text: After the Surfer leaves Johnny able to swap powers by touch, Ben trades powers with him for a moment. Later, when Johnny takes the whole team's powers to fight Doom, Ben knocks Doom off the board with a crane.
add.whoA: Swaps powers with Ben for a moment, then takes on Doom with his help.
add.whoB: Swaps powers with Johnny, then knocks Doom off the board for him.

add.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
add.text: In London, Sue holds the falling London Eye level with a force field so Ben can lift it back into place and save its riders.
add.whoA: Lifts the London Eye back into place while Sue holds it level.
add.whoB: Holds the London Eye level so Ben can lift it back.

add.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
add.text: Wong calls Bruce and Carol in to Kamar-Taj to study the Ten Rings with Shang-Chi and Katy, and they find the rings are sending out a beacon.
add.whoA: Calls Bruce in to study the Ten Rings at Kamar-Taj.
add.whoB: The scientist Wong calls in to study the Ten Rings.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2
add.text: Breaking into the Church of Gibborim, Molly rips open the box holding Geoffrey and carries him back to the Hostel.
add.whoA: Alex's father. Molly frees him from a box at the church and carries him out.
add.whoB: The girl who frees Geoffrey from a box and carries him to safety.

add.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
add.text: When Frances takes Anne, Dan calls Eddie to tell him where she is, then helps him at Grace Cathedral by setting Carnage on fire.
add.whoA: Calls Eddie when Anne is taken, then sets Carnage on fire.
add.whoB: Anne's ex, whom Dan calls when Frances takes her.

add.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
add.text: Mrs. Chen keeps Eddie supplied with chocolate in exchange for Venom guarding her store. When Anne comes looking for Venom, she scolds her for breaking Eddie's heart.
add.whoA: Trades chocolate for Venom guarding her store.
add.whoB: A friend whose Venom guards Mrs. Chen's store.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Jameson turns down Peter's ordinary photos and haggles over a Spider-Man shot. Later he fires and rehires Peter in one breath to cover his son's party.
add.whoA: Peter's stingy boss, who haggles over every shot.
add.whoB: Jameson's photographer, fired and rehired in one breath.

add.title: Spider-Man 3
add.text: Jameson pits Peter against Eddie Brock for a staff job. After Peter exposes Eddie's faked photo, Jameson fires Eddie and makes Peter staff photographer.
add.whoA: Peter's boss, who gives him the staff job.
add.whoB: Jameson's new staff photographer.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Robbie presses Jameson for a front page and insists Spider-Man is not a menace. When Mary Jane goes missing, he brings Jameson the news.
add.whoA: An editor who argues Spider-Man is no menace.
add.whoB: Robbie's boss, who runs Spider-Man as a menace.

add.title: Spider-Man 3
add.text: Robbie confirms to Jameson that Eddie Brock's photo is a fake and warns that the Bugle must print a retraction.
add.whoA: An editor who proves Eddie's photo is fake.
add.whoB: Robbie's boss, forced into a retraction.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Betty relays a call from Jameson's wife about his lost checkbook, and Jameson has her pay the garbage man who brings in Spider-Man's suit.
add.whoA: A secretary who relays his calls and pays out his deals.
add.whoB: Sends Betty running with his orders.

add.title: Spider-Man 3
add.text: Betty reminds Jameson to watch his blood pressure, and he snaps at her for swooning over Peter.
add.whoA: A secretary who reminds him to watch his blood pressure.
add.whoB: Snaps at Betty for swooning over Peter.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Hoffman suggests the name Doctor Octopus, and Jameson brushes it off, then claims it as his own.
add.whoA: A staffer whose villain name Jameson takes.
add.whoB: Takes Ted's Doctor Octopus idea as his own.

add.title: Spider-Man 3
add.text: Jameson loses patience with Hoffman's new slogan pitch, and when Hoffman pipes up again, tells him to shut up and get out.
add.whoA: A staffer whose pitches Jameson shouts down.
add.whoB: Shouts down Ted's slogan pitch.

add.title: Spider-Man 3
add.text: Ursula scolds Peter for snapping at her father over the rent. When he apologizes, she tells him he is a good boy.
add.whoA: The landlord's daughter, who forgives him for snapping.
add.whoB: A tenant Ursula forgives for snapping at her father.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Mary Jane comes to May's surprise birthday party for Peter, and May asks her to lend a hand with the food.
add.whoA: A family friend at Peter's birthday party.
add.whoB: Peter's aunt, who throws his surprise party.

add.title: Spider-Man 3
add.text: Worried after Peter learns who really killed Ben, May calls Mary Jane, who goes to check on him.
add.whoA: The girl she calls when Peter is in trouble.
add.whoB: Peter's aunt, who calls her out of worry for him.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Bernard checks in with Harry at the Osborn home before leaving for the night, and Harry bids him good night.
add.whoA: The family butler, still keeping the house.
add.whoB: The son of the house Bernard serves.
